The cellular connectivity option adds complexity.', 'Differentiation': '• Moderate – The tool-free installation and reliance on proximity detection offer some differentiation, but the market is competitive.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – No specific plan for demonstrating impact beyond ‘local alarms’ and ‘ping’ functionality. Relies on user perception of security.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Adequate – Acknowledges supply chain and multi-user challenges. • Offers some unique features (tool-free installation, proximity detection).
• Demonstrates some level of development progress.', 'Cons': '• Lacks specific details about development, revenue, and impact.
• ‘Final prototypes’ are not reassuring without more concrete evidence.
